# One invoice and one bill, for the owners of
# an_owner_of_each_kind_with_an_address.txt.
#
# Enough of a document for `print-invoice` and `print-bill` to render, which
# is what the address round trip is checked against: a printed document is
# meant to be readable back, and reading one back emptied the owner's address
# because the block it carried named no address keys and an absent key means
# the empty string.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-ADDR for C-ADDR and BILL-ADDR for V-ADDR.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_printed_document_does_not_blank_an_address.py.
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

invoice "INV-ADDR"
	customer_id: "C-ADDR"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false

bill "BILL-ADDR"
	vendor_id: "V-ADDR"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 50
		taxable: false
